context: A mom and son chat about an outing
purpose: Teach: ガーデニング/セーフ/ニヤニヤ/エレガント/お決まり/打てる/アシ/小さかっ

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、庭でガーデニング、ぼくも、お手伝いするよ。
lines.en: Mom, I want to help you with the gardening in the garden.
lines.style: Bright, eager opening. Quick pace. Slight breathlessness from wanting to be included. Hopeful lift on the final word.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。バス、駆け込みセーフで、乗れたわね、よかった。
lines.en: Yes. I'm so glad we made it onto that bus in time.
lines.style: Warm acknowledgment. Relaxed, relieved exhale. Gentle smile in the voice. Natural pace, almost conversational.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お父さんが、お祝いのプレゼント見て、ニヤニヤしてたよ。
lines.en: Dad was looking at the gift and couldn't stop grinning.
lines.style: Quietly delighted observation. Quick, conspiratorial tone — sharing something he noticed. Slight giggle underlying the words. Eyes bright.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ピアノの先生、エレガントな雰囲気の方ね。
lines.en: The piano teacher has such an elegant, graceful way about her.
lines.style: Soft, appreciative reflection. Thoughtful pause before speaking. Gentle tone, almost admiring. Trailing off slightly, like she's noticing something quietly beautiful.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お決まりの遊び、いつもの公園で、しよう!
lines.en: Let's do our usual game at the regular park!
lines.style: Sudden brightening. Excited pitch on the opening. Quick energy. Emphasis on familiarity and play — this is something he loves.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: バッティングで、ボール、しっかり打てる子、お父さんに、似たのね。
lines.en: You really have a strong batting swing — just like your dad.
lines.style: Warm observation, gentle pride underneath. Slow, affectionate pace. Soft smile. The comparison is complimentary, not corrective.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 体育の時間、アシスタントの先生、優しいんだよ。
lines.en: The assistant teacher in PE class is really kind.
lines.style: Simple, bright statement. Genuine fondness in the delivery. Natural conversational pace. Not performing — just sharing something he likes.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 去年の翔くん、体、もう少し小さかったわよ、可愛かった。
lines.en: You were so much smaller last year — it was adorable.
lines.style: Soft, tender nostalgia. Slow, slightly wistful pace. Gentle wonder at how quickly he's growing. Warmth and a touch of ache underneath.
